مُدَبَّجٌ Ornamented with دِيبَاج. (K.) You say طَيْلَسَانٌ مُدَبَّجٌ A طيلسان [q. v.] of which the ends, edges, or borders, are so ornamented. (Mgh, TA.) ―
-b2- أَرْضٌ مُدَبَجَةٌ (tropical:) Land adorned with meadows, or gardens. (A.) ―
-b3- مُدَبَّجٌ also signifies (assumed tropical:) A species of the هَام [or owl]. (T, K.) ―
-b4- And (assumed tropical:) A species of aquatic bird, (T, K,) of ugly appearance, called أَغْيَرُ مُدَبَّجٌ, with puffedout feathers, and ugly head, found in water with the [bird called] نُحَام. (T.) ―
-b5- And, applied to a man, (TA,) (assumed tropical:) Having an ugly head and make (K, TA) and face. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
